chemistry.effect_size_direction: excluded incomplete rows minus complete rows

claim_boundary: The analysis diagnoses sensitivity of one fixed Docking-44 Vina matrix to its observed missingness pattern. Equal-N controls separate unusual complete-case support from sample-size reduction descriptively, but are not a population randomization test because missingness was not randomized. Chemical effect sizes describe association with inclusion and do not identify a causal missingness mechanism. Zero residual completion is an additive-model sensitivity and does not recover unknown docking scores.

complete_row_identity_check.interpretation: these two surfaces are algebraically identical; their comparison verifies that the complete-case contrast is a support change, not an imputation change

data_dictionary.equal_n_control_estimand: distribution of residual PR across random ligand subsets having exactly the complete-case row count, drawn from the primary full processed surface
data_dictionary.missingness: a missing docking-score cell; mechanism is not assumed to be random
data_dictionary.observational_unit: one ligand row scored against 44 targets
data_dictionary.primary_estimand: target-correlation participation-ratio dimension of the two-way-centred target-mean-imputed surface

equal_n_random_support_control.interpretation: descriptive equal-N support-selection diagnostic, not a population p-value; every random support is sampled from the primary mean-imputed full ligand set without replacement

observed_cell_wls_diagnostics.objective: unweighted least squares over observed cells

complete_rows_observed_scores.interpretation: complete-case support; no imputation is applied

observed_cell_wls_zero_residual_completi.interpretation: additive effects fitted only on observed cells; missing residuals are completed by their fitted additive expectation of zero

target_mean_imputed_restricted_to_comple.interpretation: primary processed matrix restricted to exactly the complete-case rows

target_median_imputation_full_support.interpretation: same full support; changes only imputed values
